Title: lsj: akhenathen recruiting a shambling hordes

Messages.Author: Tetragrammaton
Messages.Body:
I tried a serch on google about this but haven't found
the answer...
If say, akhenathen (with 3 life) tries to recruit
a shambling horde, the action passes, does
the shambling comes to play or not ?

I'm say this by the RTR
"14) If a minion takes an action but the acting player loses control of it
before the action is successful, the action simply ends. A player loses
control of a minion that is burned, stolen, and so on...."

thanks in advance

Emiliano, v:ekn prince of Rome

>Yes.

If a hypothetical ally with 3 life that could play cards requiring
Necromancy as a vampire, but lacking Akhenaten's shuffle-into-library
text, played Shambling Hordes, would the dead ally hit the ash heap in
time to satisfy the Hordes' hunger for fresh brains?

I.e., what's the timing of the ally's paying the action cost in pseudo-blood
life, dying due to lack of life, going to the ash heap, and the Hordes
coming into play and requiring the removal of an ally from the ash heap?

gomi
